title: Simplify
text: $$r P \left(1-\frac{T}{P}\right)=r \left(P-T\right)$$, so $$P'=r \left(P-T\right) \left(1-\frac{P}{K}\right)$$, which is a quadratic in $$P$$.

title: Maximize
text: The quadratic $$r \left(P-T\right) \left(1-\frac{P}{K}\right)$$ is zero at $$P=T$$ and $$P=K$$. A parabola peaks halfway between its zeros, at $$P=\frac{K+T}{2}$$.
